description: Joan Phillip, the NDP MLA for Vancouver-Strathcona and wife of Union of British Columbia Indian Chiefs (UBCIC) Grand Chief Stewart Phillip, has died.
title: B.C. NDP MLA Joan Phillip dead at 74

description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Friday said the U.S. has entered an agreement with Venezuela to take control of 65 billion barrels of the South American country's oil reserves.
title: Trump says U.S. makes deal to control 65 billion barrels of Venezuelan oil reserves

author: Amina Zafar
description: Squishy toys have triggered recalls, seizures and burn warnings abroad. Health Canada has received 36 reports involving squishy dumpling toys, including injuries, but says it has not confirmed a specific health or safety risk.
title: Warnings over squishy toy hazards expand globally

author: Sheena Goodyear
description: Before the ink had even dried on U.S. President Donald Trump's executive order to rename Lake Ontario, a Canadian company was already selling hats with the Great Lake's true name emblazoned on it.
title: Ottawa couple's 'Lake Ontario' hats selling like hotcakes after Trump's executive order

author: Laura Fraser
description: A decade ago, Meghan Cliffel believed she was being watched by members of a cult who were out to kill her and her young daughters. In fact, she was experiencing postpartum psychosis, the condition at the heart of the Lindsay Clancy trial. But Cliffel got treatment and went on to have a third baby — because she advocated for support.
title: Postpartum psychosis is terrifying but treatable, this survivor says. The challenge is finding support

author: Basem Boshra
description: CBC’s reporting on terrorism, wherever it occurs, has always been guided by the principle of attribution, and like other major news organizations, it has been our practice for decades.
title: How and why CBC News will adjust its 9/11 language guidance

description: No Canadians will enter the singles draws at the U.S. Open through the qualifying tournament after Bianca Andreescu and Liam Draxl lost in final round action Friday in New York.
title: Andreescu, fellow Canadian Draxl lose in final round of U.S. Open qualifying

author: Aura Carreño Rosas
description: Animal Justice is calling for Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) to investigate the death in a Chicago aquarium of Peekachu, a 23-year-old beluga from Marineland in Niagara Falls, Ont., that was part of ongoing relocation efforts involving other whales and dolphins.
title: Animal Justice urges investigation into Marineland beluga death in Chicago, wants relocation efforts halted

author: Kayla McLean
description: Jake Reiner this week gave his first sit-down interview since the killing of his parents, filmmaker Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner, in California in December. He told KABC-TV about the shock he felt after being told his parents were dead and the complicated feelings he has for his younger brother, Nick, who's currently facing murder charges in the killings.
title: Rob Reiner's son Jake on his parents' killings: 'I will never understand why this happened'

author: Sara Jabakhanji
description: Air Canada announced an expanded mobility aid policy Friday that will allow customers t
title: Air Canada will now allow you up to 3 mobility aids on flights in expanded policy

author: Alex Flood
description: The Ontario Superior Court of Justice has approved an opt-in process for current and former players in the Ontario Hockey League and Western Hockey League who allege they were victims of abuse or hazing.
title: Junior hockey players in OHL, WHL can seek compensation for alleged abuse, court says

author: Helen Surgenor
description: Dolly Parton's long history of philanthropy is well-documented, but a touching tribute from her sister reveals how deeply the spirit of giving was entrenched in her.
title: Dolly Parton's sister says singer was still thinking of others while battling cancer

author: Chris Iorfida
description: A number of U.S. lawmakers called on Donald Trump to end the war with Iran as it reached its six-month mark on Friday, while the U.S. president has given off mixed signals regarding the state of the conflict.
title: Iran war hits 6-month milestone with Trump's attention largely elsewhere

author: Dan Taekema
description: The mayor of Kingston, Ont., says a snicker is the only response Donald Trump will be getting from his community following the U.S. president's renaming of Lake Ontario as Lake America. "The best thing we can possibly do is just ignore the silliness," Bryan Paterson says.
title: 'Lake America'? Trump's 'utterly ridiculous' renaming met with laughter in Kingston

author: Hannah Alberga
description: People from Ebola-affected countries will continue to be banned from entering Canada for another 30 days, prolonging the state of limbo for tens of thousands of people who have had their residency applications suspended since May.
title: Canada extends Ebola travel restrictions for another 30 days

description: Skygazers got to see a partial lunar eclipse across the Americas, Europe and Africa on Thursday evening into Friday.
title: IN PHOTOS | Partial lunar eclipse here and abroad

description: Syrian President Ahmed al-Sharaa appointed the former commander of a now-dissolved Kurdish-led fighting force as a presidential adviser on Friday, reflecting a rapprochement between the two longtime civil war adversaries.
title: Syrian president names former commander of Kurdish-led fighting force as adviser

author: Chris Brown
description: An unannounced but highly visible flight to Moscow by CIA Director John Ratcliffe aboard a U.S. Air Force transport plane this week has ignited a fierce debate over Vladimir Putin’s next military move. With Russia’s volunteer recruitment drying up and its economy straining under the weight of 1.4 million casualties, intelligence briefs suggest Putin is preparing a massive, unpopular mobilization of 600,000 new troops.
title: What the CIA director’s mystery trip to Moscow says about Putin's next move

author: Jesmeen Gill
description: An Edmonton father has been convicted of manslaughter in connection with the death of his five-week-old baby boy.
title: Edmonton father convicted of manslaughter in death of his 5-week-old infant
Canada's economy grew by 3.3% in the second quarter, showing sharp recovery
Canada's economy has found its footing. But is it enough to survive the U.S. trade war?

author: Hannah Spray
description: The drug bust happened after police tracked the cellphone of a man they believed was helping facilitate shipments of methamphetamine crossing the U.S. border into Canada at Coutts, Alta.
title: Appeal court orders new trial in $4M drug seizure near Sask.-Alta. border

author: Tara Carman
description: Donald Trump is hardly the first U.S. president whose government has imposed steep duties on Canadian lumber. The tariffs are the latest chapter in a dispute that's been going on for more than four decades. Here’s how we got here.
title: How Trump’s lumber tariffs made a bad situation worse in B.C.

author: Stephanie Cram
description: First Nations from across Treaty 6 territory have been marking this month’s 150th anniversary of the signing of the 1876 agreement with the Crown. But for some, the discussion around the upcoming referendum on Alberta independence is casting a shadow over it.
title: Treaty 6 was signed 150 years ago. First Nations worry a push for Alberta independence puts it at risk

author: Arturo Chang
description: A hotel chain must pay more than $100,000 to three foreign workers employed at one of its locations in Manitoba after the province's labour board denied the company's appeal.
title: Labour board rejects appeal by chain that underpaid foreign workers at Manitoba hotel

author: Jenna Olsen
description: When the consultation and surgery wait times are combined, the total waits for hip and knee replacements in Nova Scotia are longer than they were a decade ago. In 2015, Nova Scotians could expect a total median wait of 265 days for a hip replacement — in 2025, it was 292 days.
title: Nova Scotians wait over 500 ‘painful’ days for surgery consultations

description: Norway's King ‌Harald, a ​reformer who emerged ​from the shadow ​of his well-loved ‌father over more than three decades on the ‌throne, has died aged ​89, the royal palace said on ​Friday.
title: King Harald V, Norway's reform-minded head of state, dead at 89
Why Lindsay Clancy, on trial for the deaths of her 3 children, has so many supporters

author: Gloria Henriquez
description: Quebec is facing sharp criticism and calls to reform its French-language exemption process for students with disabilities following the removal of an autistic student from a local college.
title: After autistic student denied, Quebec faces calls to reform French exemption process

author: Inayat Singh
description: It's unclear whether Trump can unilaterally rename the lake, whose name predates European colonization of the Americas and has been widely recognized internationally for centuries. But the renaming belies a concerted push by the Trump administration to hold back important U.S.-Canada collaboration on scientific research and restoration work in the Great Lakes.
title: Despite Trump's renaming of Lake Ontario, Great Lakes endure as symbol of U.S.-Canada collaboration

author: Jessica Wong
description: Changes are coming for teen Instagram and Facebook users after parent company Meta agreed to platform changes in a landmark U.S. settlement to resolve claims of online harms to youth. Experts tell CBC News what's changing, how widely and what impact this might have going forward.
title: How teen accounts on Instagram and Facebook are changing after Meta's $18B US settlement

author: Andre Mayer
description: Coyote vs. Acme, which opens in theatres Aug. 28, is not only the latest chapter in a timeless battle of wills, but the newest entry in the pantheon of anti-capitalist films. Here are seven of our favourites.
title: In honour of Coyote vs. Acme, we salute some excellent anti-capitalist movies

author: Jackson Weaver
description: The Dog Stars is about the same thing as every other post-apocalypse film you've seen, but this time without the guts or energy to make it believably harrowing.
title: Jacob Elordi's The Dog Stars is an apocalyptic adaptation

author: Jack Farrell
description: Premier Danielle Smith and three of her ministers spent an hour Thursday fielding calls and online questions from Albertans who say they are concerned about artificial intelligence data centres being built in the province.
title: Danielle Smith takes questions at virtual town hall on data centres in Alberta, NDP calls for pause
